impl.summary: Theme 1.2.0 + plugin 1.2.0 (headers, constants, readme stable tag). (1) Footer credit is now "Built with ♥ for our veterans by Cosmick Media." from three settings — footer.credit (default "Built with ♥ for our veterans", ♥ → heart icon, trailing full stop trimmed before "by"), footer.credit_by_label ("Cosmick Media"), footer.credit_by_url (https://www.cosmickmedia.com); the label is a plain 12px white@60 link (target _blank, rel noopener noreferrer, underline only on hover), omitted entirely when the label is empty. Added to Settings\Schema (Footer tab with help text), theme inc/defaults.php, footer.php, payload-src/records/settings.json, and applied to the local hk9_settings option via Store::update. Bottom bar measured 49px at 1440 (reference) and 113px at 390 (unchanged 3-row stack; credit stays one 16px line). (2) Default page template (page.php): hero band (title + excerpt, Hero (band) panel: eyebrow/heading/intro/pattern) that can now be unticked under Page sections (plugin default.php definition: can_hide => true) for a plain start (title as the card's h1 inside .hk9-page-plain), content card (.hk9-prose), optional Call to action band (hidden by default; theme fallback section-defaults mirror it; 80px spacer between overlap card and the band). Editor guidance notice now has a default-template message. Ten theme block patterns in theme/heartland-k9s/patterns/*.php (standard headers, category "Heartland" registered at init 9): text + image left/right (media-text, placeholder assets/img/placeholder-4x3.svg), three feature cards, CTA band, FAQ (details), two buttons, quote/testimonial, stats row, contact details (pre-filled from contact.* settings), section heading with crimson divider. Block styles registered in inc/blocks.php with CSS in _prose.scss compiled into both content.css and editor.css (Card, Card (muted), Navy band, Tinted band, Statistic, Callout, Lead, Crimson bar, Thin rule, Testimonial, Checklist, Navy button; core buttons = 56px CTA buttons; details summaries get the crimson chevron). Verified by inserting all patterns into a temporary tmp-patterns page (screenshots patterns-1440.png / patterns-390.png), fixing card flex-centering, card rhythm, media-text mobile padding, band button stacking; verified in the block editor (iframe canvas computed styles match the front end, patterns listed under Heartland, notice + Hero/CTA panels present, no console errors) and a classic "Sample Page"-style page with hero, plain start and hero+CTA. Temp pages and auto-drafts deleted. (3) Settings audit: everything user-facing already resolved to settings/menus/sections except: TikTok social added (contact.tiktok + Simple Icons glyph in tools/build-icons.mjs, rendered only when set, verified visually then cleared), search placeholder (blog.search_placeholder), 404/empty-search helpful links now a menu location "Helpful links (404 & search)" with the reference fallback (Blog tab note), BarKode contact-line fallback uses the site title (theme + plugin), Footer tab description + "Column links" note link to Appearance → Menus; menu locations all named clearly. (4) Docs: admin-guide (new-pages/patterns section, menus table, footer credit, TikTok, blog options; two new admin screenshots), ARCHITECTURE §5/§7/§11, STATUS, theme readme changelog. Lite payload rebuilt (only option:hk9_settings changed).

issues: package.json (new 'release' script) and tools/release.mjs changed on disk during this session from another process — not touched by me; left as found.

'Show hero' is implemented as the Page sections checkbox (hero_band gets can_hide => true on the default template only) rather than a new field inside the hero panel: hero_band shares one meta key/field set across 16 templates, so adding a field only for 'default' would force a distinct meta key and orphan the hk9_sec_hero_band data already stored on the imported default-template pages (Privacy Policy, News, drafts).

The Contact details pattern copies the phone/e-mail/address/hours into the page at insertion time (block content is static); the footer/Contact page still follow Settings. Documented in the admin guide.

WordPress caches the theme pattern file list per theme Version — on the local stack the list was stale until the bump to 1.2.0 (documented in ARCHITECTURE §11); a site upgrading to 1.2.0 invalidates it automatically.

review.verdict: PASS — all claims verified on the local stack; no blocking or medium findings. Footer credit renders exactly "Built with ♥ for our veterans by Cosmick Media." (heart = 12px SVG with accessible title "love", link href https://www.cosmickmedia.com/ target=_blank rel="noopener noreferrer", escaped via esc_url/esc_html, 12px rgba(255,255,255,.6), weight 400, no background/border/image, text-decoration none → underline on hover). Bottom bar 49px @1440 / 113px @390, credit line 16px. Three new footer settings + blog.search_placeholder + contact.tiktok each have a Schema default, a Store sanitizer (text → sanitize_text_field keeps ♥; url → esc_url_raw), a UI field with help text, a theme inc/defaults.php fallback, a payload-src/records/settings.json entry, and a consuming template (footer.php / searchform.php). All 10 heartland-k9s/* patterns parse with parse_blocks: no freeform/unregistered blocks, serialize round-trip identical, category "heartland-k9s" → "Heartland", 0 core/* patterns. page.php hero toggle works (hidden=['hero_band'] → .hk9-page-plain with h1 title, no band; default → band + card + spacer, CTA hidden; CTA ticked → band rendered). Theme grep for hardcoded org data is clean (only the Google Maps / PayPal URL builders in template-parts, and the plugin-less defaults file). sections-test 47/0, core-fixes 93/0, axe /privacy-policy/ 0/0/0/0 at both widths, php -l clean on every touched PHP file, no hk9 entries in debug.log (only a third-party gravityforms textdomain notice). No tmp-/auto-draft posts left behind.

findings.issue: The Contact details pattern copies contact.* values into post content at insertion time, so a later change under Heartland → Settings → Contact will not update pages that already used the pattern. This is documented in the pattern description and admin-guide, so it is a known trade-off rather than a defect.
findings.fix: No change required; optionally add one sentence to the admin-guide patterns table reminding staff to re-insert or edit the block after changing phone/e-mail settings.

findings.issue: Leaving footer.credit empty hides the entire credit line including the "by Cosmick Media" part (by design; the help text says so). If the client ever wants only the developer credit they must keep a non-empty credit string.
findings.fix: None needed; behaviour matches the Schema help text and ARCHITECTURE §7.
